rule.statement: stop once the best validation HV has improved by less than 0.5% over the last 1,000 updates, after at least 1,000 updates (the PPO warm-start rule, daniel/convergence.py); hard cap 8,000 updates, reported as 'capped'

start.name: Model Soup (shared base)
start.note: the start of the converged Model Soup run (a rerun from this network under the same rule)

MFSP.name: Shrink and perturb
MFSP.change: before fine-tuning, every weight of the Model Soup start becomes 0.3 x weight + 0.0001 x the same weight of a freshly initialised network (seed 111, the From-scratch initialisation); the contrastive reference is this shrunk-and-perturbed network
MFSP.source: Ash & Adams, 'On Warm-Starting Neural Network Training', NeurIPS 2020, Section 4: theta <- lambda * theta + p, p ~ N(0, sigma^2), 'in practice ... adding parameters from a scaled, randomly-initialized network'; lambda = 0.3 and noise scale 0.0001 are the values the paper uses for the pre-training-then-fine-tuning case (Section 4.2, Figure 9)
MFSP.base: the converged Model Soup run's flags (tools/ec2_runner.py: cc_args CCSBAVG, rerun), plus the flags above

MFNA.name: No anchor
MFNA.change: the same pairwise loss with the reference log-probabilities removed: -log sigmoid(beta * (l_better - l_worse)) instead of -log sigmoid(beta * [(l_better - l_better_ref) - (l_worse - l_worse_ref)])
MFNA.base: the converged Model Soup run's flags (tools/ec2_runner.py: cc_args CCSBAVG, rerun), plus the flags above

MFPR.name: Random preference input
MFPR.change: the preference-input columns of the first actor and critic layers keep the values of a freshly initialised network (seed 111, as in From scratch) instead of zero; every other weight from the merge
MFPR.base: the converged Model Soup run's flags (tools/ec2_runner.py: cc_args CCSBAVG, rerun), plus the flags above

SOUP.name: Model Soup (shared base)
SOUP.network: the Model Soup start, --init_mode full (preference columns zero)

DIST.name: Distillation
DIST.network: the distilled student, --init_mode no_critic (as the Distillation arm)

RAND.name: Random initialisation
RAND.network: no --init_from: the fresh seed-111 network (the From-scratch start)

MFSP.name: Shrink and perturb
MFSP.network: the arm's start: before fine-tuning, every weight of the Model Soup start becomes 0.3 x weight + 0.0001 x the same weight of a freshly initialised network (seed 111, the From-scratch initialisation); the contrastive reference is this shrunk-and-perturbed network

MFNA.name: No anchor
MFNA.network: the arm's start: the same pairwise loss with the reference log-probabilities removed: -log sigmoid(beta * (l_better - l_worse)) instead of -log sigmoid(beta * [(l_better - l_better_ref) - (l_worse - l_worse_ref)])

MFPR.name: Random preference input
MFPR.network: the arm's start: the preference-input columns of the first actor and critic layers keep the values of a freshly initialised network (seed 111, as in From scratch) instead of zero; every other weight from the merge

diagnostics.near_inactive: |activation| <= 0.01 on at least 99% of the entries of the validation batch (every state of the greedy validation rollouts, unfinished schedules only)
diagnostics.saturated_tanh: |tanh activation| >= 0.99 on at least 99% of those entries
diagnostics.gradient: the run's first contrastive batch (same instances and preferences for every network), before clipping
diagnostics.preference_sensitivity: on every state of the greedy validation rollouts, the policy under each of the 15 validation preferences

gap_criterion: an arm closes the gap to From scratch if its evaluation HV is at least From scratch's converged evaluation HV; otherwise the report gives the share of the gap closed, (arm - Model Soup) / (From scratch - Model Soup), on evaluation HV (Model Soup and From scratch: the converged runs). Single seed: numbers only, no significance claims
